settings.editor: Our Services

settings.title: Translation & Language Services Built Around You

settings.editor: Whatever your language need — a single certificate or a multilingual product launch — we match it with a specialist linguist and a rigorous quality process.

settings.description_text: Adapt websites, apps and software for new markets with culturally sensitive localization that respects tags, placeholders and style guides.
Accurate, readable translation of brochures, contracts, reports, court papers, medical records and more.
Certified translations of birth and marriage certificates, degrees and legal papers for embassies and immigration.
Expert editors make your text error-free, natural-sounding and correctly formatted before it goes live.
Time-coded transcription and translation of interviews, research audio and video — even with background noise.
Consecutive and simultaneous interpreting in person, over the phone or by video conference.
Perfectly synced SRT and VobSub subtitles, open or closed captions, soft or hard-coded.
Persuasive blogs, social posts, ad copy, case studies and email campaigns written for your audience.
Reading, writing and listening tests and practice material for foreign and second-language learners.
Phonetic transcription, pronunciation validation, PoS tagging and corpus or dictionary building.
Typesetting, layout and design of translated brochures, flyers and books — ready to print or publish.

settings.description_text: Founded by a translation scholar

settings.editor: Why Pak Translations
We combine academic expertise with real-world project management, so you get translations that are accurate, culturally right and delivered when promised.

settings.title_text: A one-stop shop for language needs
settings.description_text: From document translation to website localization and text-to-speech linguistic data — one partner for every language task.
Every linguist passes a skills test before onboarding and follows our Translator Instructions, so quality is consistent on every project.
We answer questions quickly — even after office hours — and stay available for post-delivery queries.
Deadlines are agreed up front and backed by a team that can step in. Top-quality work, priced to fit your budget.

settings.editor: How It Works
Six clear steps from first message to final file — so you always know where your project stands.

settings.description_text: We discuss your requirements, ask questions, request reference material and suggest how to get the best result.
You confirm the order through our simple order form, by email or on WhatsApp.
We assign your project to the most relevant native linguist, who translates and self-proofreads it.
Our QA team checks formatting, layout, punctuation, terminology and missing lines.
Your finished translation is delivered in the format you need — on or before the deadline.
Need a tweak or have a question? We remain available long after delivery.

settings.editor: Certified Translation

settings.title: Certified Translation for Immigration, Visa & Legal Documents

settings.editor: Applying for a visa, immigration or university abroad? We translate and certify your personal and legal documents so they are ready to submit. On request we can provide a signed translator affidavit and guide you through the notarization process.
Languages
We cover major world languages and hard-to-find regional ones such as Balochi, Saraiki, Hindko, Sylheti and Rohingya — plus non-English pairs like German, French or Spanish into other languages.
Proven Results
A few examples of the localization, subtitling and audio-visual work we deliver for clients around the world.
Ongoing localization for one of the leading mobile phone brands at 99%+ accuracy.
English SRT subtitles for a CPEC documentary, produced by 10 subtitlers and reviewed by 2 linguists.
Rare-language audio-visual translation into English, QA'd and delivered on deadline.

settings.editor: Meet the Founder

settings.title: Led by Dr. Muhammad Salman Riaz

settings.editor: Pak Translations was founded on commitment, honesty, perseverance and simplicity — and on the belief that every message deserves to be understood exactly as intended.

Dr. Riaz holds a Ph.D. in Translation Studies from the University of Leeds, UK and an M.Phil. in Linguistics from the National University of Modern Languages, Pakistan. With over a decade of experience in translation, localization, QA, transcription, subtitling and language-test development, he personally oversees the quality of our work.
Dr. Muhammad Salman RiazFounder & CEO, Pak Translations

settings.editor: FAQs
Quick answers about our translation services, pricing and certified translations. Still curious? Our team replies fast on WhatsApp.

tabs.tab_title: How much do translation services cost?
tabs.tab_content: Pricing depends on the language pair, word count, subject matter (for example legal or medical) and your deadline. Send us your document through the quote form or on WhatsApp and we will reply with a clear, no-obligation quote.

tabs.tab_title: Do you provide certified translations for immigration and visas?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We translate and certify personal and legal documents such as birth and marriage certificates, degrees, transcripts and court papers. On request we can also provide a signed translator affidavit and guidance with notarization.

We work in 120+ languages across South Asia, East and Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe and Africa — including regional languages such as Urdu, Punjabi, Pashto, Sindhi, Balochi and Saraiki. See our full language list.

tabs.tab_title: Can you translate between two non-English languages?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Our services are not limited to English. We regularly handle pairs such as German, French or Spanish into other languages — just ask about your combination.

tabs.tab_title: How long does a translation take?
tabs.tab_content: It depends on the length and complexity of the content. We agree a realistic deadline with you before starting, and if anything unexpected happens we inform you immediately and reassign the work so your delivery date is protected.

tabs.tab_title: How do I place an order?
tabs.tab_content: Use our order form to share your files and requirements, or contact us by email at info@pak-translations.com or on WhatsApp at +92 337 1440929.

tabs.tab_title: Do you offer support after delivery?
tabs.tab_content: Absolutely. If you have questions or need a revision after delivery, we are here to help — our support does not end when the project does.
